events.outcome: MTS support updated in 2026 confirms the Сохраняю номер service exists for eligible no-monthly-fee tariffs and that most lines face termination after roughly six months without qualifying top-up or spend. The product-price page remains geo-fragile, so tariff eligibility should stay constrained.

data.acquisitionSummary: MTS "Сохраняю номер" is a keep-number add-on for eligible tariffs without a monthly fee. It is managed through My MTS / personal account; this is a retention service on an existing MTS line, not a starter tariff.

keep.action: Use the Сохраняю номер service for eligible non-monthly-fee tariffs. The reviewed product evidence lists RUB349 for six months; current MTS support separately confirms the service and the default long-inactivity blocking logic.

data.chinaActivation: Russian SIM/KYC and payment constraints apply; foreign acquisition and payment from abroad can be difficult.
data.kyc: Subscriber identity registration is required; foreign-citizen rules are more restrictive and should be checked at acquisition.
data.payment: My MTS/personal-account payment; cross-border card/payment reliability is not assumed.
data.roamingSms: Not used as an admission claim in this packet.
data.refund: If a number is blocked for non-use, MTS says recovery may be possible if it has not been reassigned.
data.holdReason: Product/service is admitted backstage, but cross-border acquisition/payment and exact tariff eligibility remain material constraints.
data.tariffSummary: Сохраняю номер: reviewed product evidence RUB349/6 months; current MTS support confirms service availability and ~6-month default non-use termination patterns.
